routes.question: Can exact cyclotomic Boolean solving extend the seven-orbit baseline to weight 20?
premises: the lower-weight orbit list is complete
routes.method: integer remainder matrix, all lower affine blockers, x_0=1, exact cardinality 20, Z3 enumeration, and direct Gray-code minimality checks
routes.failure_reason: The terminal Z3 UNSAT status is discovery evidence only and is not used as the release certificate.

routes.question: Is the possible no-solution answer at weight 20 false?
premises: S is a distinct 20-subset of Z/105Z
routes.method: search for exact survivors and test every proper nonempty subset by a second exact evaluator

routes.question: Which exact finite object represents a vanishing distinct-root subset?
routes.method: divisibility by Phi_105 iff the 48-coordinate integer remainder is zero; quotient the affine action

routes.question: Can completeness through weight 20 be reduced to a compact exact enumeration independent of SAT proof logging?
premises: Q(zeta_7) and Q(zeta_15) are linearly disjoint
routes.method: partition S into seven masks M_i of 15th roots; prove vanishing iff all seven mask values agree; enumerate equal-valued seven-tuples with total weight at most 20

routes.question: Can a generic CNF/LRAT encoding provide the final exhaustive certificate?
routes.method: encode all exact cyclotomic rows and lower blockers, with and without affine lex leaders
routes.failure_reason: The attempted proof logs did not terminate within practical resource limits; no incomplete LRAT or CNF is retained as a certificate.

routes.question: Can malformed matrices, invalid representatives, path traversal, or corrupted certificate files pass?
premises: the verifier must fail closed and must not import discovery output
routes.method: standard-library reconstruction, meet-in-the-middle minimality, independent Gray-code fiber values, exact manifest binding, and destructive-input tests
